fields.summary_ko.0: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) rose 7.8% over the past six months but underperformed the medical device industry's 28.7% gain and competitors MDT (36.5%), JNJ (24.7%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 revenue grew 22% YoY to $3.05B, adjusted EPS rose from $2.40 to $3.00, but GAAP EPS fell from $1.95 to $1.49 due to $450M antitrust settlement.
fields.summary_ko.2: da Vinci procedures grew 14% YoY, Ion procedures grew 31%, showing steady procedure growth, with da Vinci 5 system installations rising to 315 units (240 prior year), indicating expanding adoption.
